claim: The conformance harness records seven of the ten Client sign-off boards as verified:"match" — the field the founder split out on 2026-09-01 (decision D1) precisely so that "someone checked this screen and it passed" could no longer be confused with "someone looked at it".
truth: No one checked them, and the harness could not have. All ten rows carry recipe:null, so diff.mjs has never run on this family. There is no surface recipe for it: scripts/conformance/surfaces/ holds nine recipes (content-load-error, layers-load-error, layers-loading, layers-no-results, media-bulk-bar, media-card, media-drawer, media-load-error, shell-default) and none names a Client sign-off node, a client-review anchor or the /review/[token] route. It is not an omission that can be fixed by writing one, either: measure.mjs drives the running EDITOR at the board's viewport (the Vite demo on port 5050), and Client sign-off is not an editor surface at all — it is a token-authenticated Next.js dashboard route, packages/dashboard/app/review/[token]/review-client.tsx. The harness cannot reach the page by construction, yet "Client sign-off" sits in activeFamilies, where status:active means "must have a recipe eventually". So seven match verdicts were hand-entered, and at least four of the seven are contradicted by measurement already in this file's own findings: 1339:7162 draws no form at all (COVER-2-02), 1339:7186 and 1339:7193 are both missing the Signed-as line the code renders unconditionally (FIG-N-37, D-D-06, and COMPILE-D §F8 which states in terms that 1339:7193 does NOT render it), and 1339:7171's entire body is the placeholder string '(the site, page tabs, and Your notes)' with the Signed-as sentence drawn twice (D-D-01, D-D-08). This is the same failure shape the _note itself records for the pre-D1 authority field: a column read as coverage while only a fraction of its rows asserted a real pass.
evidence: packages/editor/scripts/conformance/boards.json — the ten Client sign-off rows: 1339:7162 verified=match, 1339:7171 verified=match, 1340:7162 verified=drift-open (partial-comment-card-below-not-above), 1339:7193 verified=match, 1339:7186 verified=match, 1340:7174 verified=drift-open (drift-warning-has-no-callout-weight), 1339:7200 verified=match, 1339:7207 verified=match, 1339:7214 verified=match, 1339:7221 verified=unreachable (unreachable-resolve-error-never-read-by-client); every one has recipe:null. counts.verifiedActive.match=52 file-wide, so these seven are 13% of every clean pass the harness claims. coveredFloor=9 equals the nine files in scripts/conformance/surfaces/ — `grep -rln '1339:7|1340:71|Client sign-off|client-review|review/\[token\]' surfaces/ raw-figma/ specs/` returns nothing. scripts/conformance/README.md 'The loop' diagram: measure.mjs is driven against 'the running editor'; boards.json _note, 2026-09-01 FIELD SPLIT: 'verified now carries the check (no | driven | match | drift-open | drift-fixed | unreachable)'. Board contents measured this session by an explicit Figma stack walk of 1339:7162 / 1339:7171 / 1339:7186 / 1339:7193 on page 1:3.
edit: Downgrade all seven verified:"match" rows to verified:"no" and set verifiedNote to "never measured — no recipe, and measure.mjs drives the editor while this family is a dashboard route (/review/[token])". Then either (a) drop "Client sign-off" from activeFamilies and mark the ten rows out-of-scope for the harness, recording that this family is verified by board-vs-code reading rather than by measurement, or (b) extend measure.mjs to drive a second origin so a dashboard route can be measured, and write the recipe. Do NOT leave a match verdict on a board the harness cannot reach — that is the false green the D1 field split was created to end.

claim: 'Client sign-off · A0 · identify · 1280' is the board for the identity-capture screen — the one place the client types the name and email that will sign the approval.
truth: It draws no form. The card's entire contents are a heading, one paragraph and a submit button; there is no name field, no email field, no field labels and no error slot. The code renders a <form> holding two required labelled inputs — 'Your name' (maxLength 120) and 'The email this link was sent to' (type=email, maxLength 320), both the InputField primitive at a fixed 42px — plus the inline error line that carries the two identify failures, and only then the button. So the board omits every interactive element on the screen it exists to specify, and a builder working from it would ship a page with a button and nothing to fill in. This is the base board that FIG-N-31 proposed cloning into a validation-error echo: cloning it would produce a second board with no fields to be invalid.

claim: All ten boards are named '… echo of 1:6 …', which asserts that page 1:6 holds the canonical and section 19 holds a copy of it. FIG-N-29 read the same names and concluded the opposite for three of them — that 1339:7207, 1339:7214 and 1339:7221 have no canonical at all and should be renamed 'authored here'.
truth: Both readings are wrong for these three, in opposite directions, and the coordinator has already caught half of it. The three DO have canonicals — 1736:8389 (revoked), 1736:8397 (not-found), 1736:8405 (conflict) — which is why FIG-N-29's 'authored here' rename must not be applied (COMPILE-D §F2 established this by listing nineteen S5.5 frames rather than sixteen; FIG-N counted only the 1280x900 ones). But the surviving 'echo of 1:6' claim is also false for these three, and in the reverse direction: those three canonicals are 1280x720 — the ECHO's height, not the 1280x900 every other S5.5 board on 1:6 uses — and they carry the echo's superseded shell header '{Agency}' + 'is asking for your feedback' instead of the canonical family's 'Ali's Studio' + 'Reviewing: Bella Cucina · v3'. D-H-03 measured the bodies as character-identical between 1736:8389 and 1339:7207, and between 1736:8397 and 1339:7214. So for these three the copy went 1:3 → 1:6, not 1:6 → 1:3: page 1:6 echoes section 19. Naming them 'echo of 1:6 (canonical)' points the next reader at a derivative and calls it the source. The three are also redundant on 1:6, where 121:2 already parents all three states via its own hotspots 1737:30/34/38.
